items.title: RHB Launches Malaysia’s First World Legend Mastercard
items.why: Issuers keep adding ultra-premium Mastercard tiers abroad. Watch whether World Legend positioning reaches US issuers.
items.summary_ai: RHB has launched a World Legend Mastercard in Malaysia, presented as the first card of its kind there.
items.take: Issuers keep adding ultra-premium Mastercard tiers abroad. Watch whether World Legend positioning reaches US issuers.
